    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_36" name="In good position" sourceRef="Gateway_WirePositionDecision" targetRef="Task_WidenPathway">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wireInGoodPosition == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" sourceRef="Task_WidenPathway" targetRef="Task_AdvanceCatheter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_38" sourceRef="Task_AdvanceCatheter" targetRef="Task_RemoveGuidewire"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_39" sourceRef="Task_RemoveGuidewire" targetRef="Task_VerifyFlowReflow"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_40" sourceRef="Task_VerifyFlowReflow" targetRef="Task_CheckCatheterPosition"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_41" sourceRef="Task_CheckCatheterPosition" targetRef="EndEvent_Procedure"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
